'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Steve Skilton DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Skilton]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
